summary: Phase 1 STRIKE 3 of 3 (FINAL/cap) on phase_1_mergeNF_succ, value-duplication route. CONCLUSIVE NEGATIVE RESULT: merge_forward_succ is NOT a theorem as the Phase-1 leaf specifies it. Two independent, rigorously-established obstructions. (1) Any renaming-mediated env-congruence bridging the wide duplicating env (full_val) and the narrow merged env (env') at depth k cannot close its quant layer even one-directionally and even at the env level: threading the wide quant hypothesis through the narrow quant assignment (nf.2 composed with renameNF (liftIdx r)(liftIdx f)) lands on the merge-roundtrip, whose elimination requires renameNF_roundtrip and hence BOTH lifted index sections f r = id AND r f = id. The merge has only r f = id (totalUnskip_skipFin); the duplication env-compatibility hcomp2 (E = e r, which full_val DOES satisfy on all positions) is NOT a substitute for the missing index section in the quant recursion. This sharpens the strike-2 bijectivity obstruction from index-level/bidirectional to env-level/single-direction. (2) INDEPENDENTLY, the conclusion quant backward direction (sub_nf.2 qnf = true implies exists a carrier witness w and realizing env for qnf) would manufacture a model witness from an ARBITRARY Bool quantifier assignment sub_nf.2. Depth 0 has no quant layer (so depth-0 merge_forward is true with only h_pred/h_ord); depth k+1 requires quant-merge-compatibility of sub_nf that no atom-level hypothesis supplies and that an abstract forward leaf cannot assume. VERDICT: the x=t-zone collapse cannot be a standalone arity-reduction lemma; it must be discharged in situ at the consumer (KampPrior.lean:391) where sub_nf is the model characteristic NF. Stopped cleanly per H6 (3-strike cap reached). LANDED SORRY-FREE/AXIOM-CLEAN reusable assets in the build path: the full renameNF infrastructure (liftIdx, renameNF, renameNF_roundtrip, renameNF_eval_iff), totalUnskip + totalUnskip_skipFin, and the depth-(k+1) merge DEFINITION mergeNF_succ + mergeNF_succ_atom (atom layer = depth-0 mergeNF). Build GREEN (1700 jobs); baseline (2 sorries 391/394, axiom set, 0 new top-level axioms) unchanged.
